t: Universe Computer: Bremermann Ceiling Desk — Simple
name: Universe Computer: Bremermann Ceiling Desk — Simple
title: Universe Computer: Bremermann Ceiling Desk — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] The universe's clock speed limit: c²/h ≈ 1.36×10⁵⁰ operations per second per kilogram. The desk computes the ceiling for any mass — the fastest any computer of that mass can ever run, physics permitting.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Bremermann ceiling for 1 kg = 1.356e+50 ops/s. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
real_world_basis: The Bremermann limit is the real, physical ceiling on computation rate.
signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation ceiling desk — the chapter's target as the efficiency target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: real machines run ~40 orders of magnitude below — the ceiling orients, it doesn't design.
math_note: Bremermann ceiling for 1 kg: 1.356e+50 ops/s [verified]; Bremermann ceiling for the Sun: 2.70e+80 ops/s [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a design that budgets to the ceiling.
how_it_works: Multiply the mass by 1.36e50 for the ops-per-second ceiling. The demo ceilings planets, stars, and the observable universe.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: Universe Computer: Cosmic Landauer Floor — Simple
name: Universe Computer: Cosmic Landauer Floor — Simple
title: Universe Computer: Cosmic Landauer Floor — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Every erased bit anywhere costs kT ln2: the desk computes the energy floor for cosmic-scale computations at cosmic temperatures (2.7 K background). Cold helps — the floor drops with temperature.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Landauer floor per bit at 2.7 K = 2.584e-23 J. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
real_world_basis: Landauer's principle at any temperature is the real floor.
signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation cosmic-floor desk — the chapter's target as the efficiency target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: the temperature is the design variable — colder is cheaper, to a point.
math_note: Landauer floor per bit at 2.7 K: 2.584e-23 J [verified]; Floor for 1e50 bits at 2.7 K: 2.590e+26 J [verified]

safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a floor quoted at the wrong temperature.
how_it_works: Multiply the bits by kT ln2 at the operating temperature. The demo floors a galaxy-brain computation.
